commencements.description: Changes 'three' to 'six' in the time limits for written statements, wage protection, and tips information.

commencements.description: Increases time off for representatives of employee safety from three to six.

commencements.subject: National Minimum Wage Act 1998
commencements.description: Extends the time limits for National Minimum Wage record access from three to six.

commencements.subject: Employment Relations Act 1999
commencements.description: In section 11 of the Employment Relations Act 1999 (right to be accompanied), in subsection (2)— in paragraph (a), for “three” substitute “six”; in paragraph (b), for “three” substitute “six”.

commencements.subject: Merchant Shipping (Working Time: Inland Waterways) Regulations 2003
commencements.description: Raises two inland waterways working time limits from three to six.

commencements.subject: Civil Aviation (Working Time) Regulations 2004
commencements.description: Raises the civil aviation working-time rights limit from 'three' to 'six'.

commencements.description: Increases two rest and leave entitlements for sea-fishermen from three to six.

commencements.subject: Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006
commencements.description: Extends employee liability information and consultation time limits from three to six.

commencements.subject: Occupational and Personal Pension Schemes (Consultation by Employers and Miscellaneous Amendment) Regulations 2006
commencements.description: Extends the time limit for pension consultation claims from three to six months.

commencements.subject: Cross-border Railway Services (Working Time) Regulations 2008
commencements.description: Extends two working time periods for cross-border railway workers from three to six.

commencements.subject: European Public Limited-Liability Company (Employee Involvement) (Great Britain) Regulations 2009
commencements.description: Increases time off for special negotiating body members from three to six.

commencements.subject: Agency Workers Regulations 2010
commencements.description: Extends the period for agency workers' rights from three to six.

commencements.subject: Equality Act 2010
commencements.description: Extends the time limit for bringing discrimination claims at work from 3 months to 6 months.

commencements.subject: Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Hours of Work) Regulations 2018
commencements.description: Extends seafarers' leave entitlement from three to six.

taxon_hygiene.description: This list covers a large amount of Chancery work which is separate from the Business List. It includes the following types of work: Property landlord and tenant residential landlord and tenant commercial trespass/squatters mortgages land registry land – including title, easements, restrictive covenants orders for sale to enforce charging orders Trusts of Land and Appointment of Trustees Act 1996 (TOLATA) Trusts variation of trusts removal of trustees claims against trustees for breach of trust issues of construction/rectification trustees/personal representatives seeking directions including Beddoe applications (a type of application made by trustees) disputes about trust property applications for prospective costs order (deciding costs issues in advance) charities applications for administration order (appointing a person to manage a company that is in financial difficulty) Probate inheritance disputes (known as contentious probate claims) rectification of wills (cases against the way a solicitor has prepared a will) substitution or removal of personal representatives cases involving the Inheritance Act cases involving the Presumption of Death Act Cases are started in the Chancery Division. Who we are We are a specialist court within the Business and Property Courts of the High Court of Justice. We are based at the Rolls Building in London. Cases in the Property, Trusts and Probate List are managed by the Chancery Masters and heard by the Chancery Division judges. findings.title: The Property, Trusts and Probate List
findings.description: This list covers a large amount of Chancery work which is separate from the Business List. It includes the following types of work: Property landlord and tenant residential landlord and tenant commercial trespass/squatters mortgages land registry land – including title, easements, restrictive covenants orders for sale to enforce charging orders Trusts of Land and Appointment of Trustees Act 1996 (TOLATA) Trusts variation of trusts removal of trustees claims against trustees for breach of trust issues of construction/rectification trustees/personal representatives seeking directions including Beddoe applications (a type of application made by trustees) disputes about trust property applications for prospective costs order (deciding costs issues in advance) charities applications for administration order (appointing a person to manage a company that is in financial difficulty) Probate inheritance disputes (known as contentious probate claims) rectification of wills (cases against the way a solicitor has prepared a will) substitution or removal of personal representatives cases involving the Inheritance Act cases involving the Presumption of Death Act Cases are started in the Chancery Division. Who we are We are a specialist court within the Business and Property Courts of the High Court of Justice. We are based at the Rolls Building in London. Cases in the Property, Trusts and Probate List are managed by the Chancery Masters and heard by the Chancery Division judges.
